jobs.title: Principal Technical Sound Designer
jobs.description: Mob Entertainment is a startup multimedia studio that is best known for our hit indie horror game " Poppy Playtime" .  This franchise is one of the hottest new properties in gaming, and our team is naturally expanding as our ambition expands. To give a taste of our brand's popularity, more than 200 billion YouTube views of Poppy Playtime related content have occurred since the game's launch 6 years ago. We’re looking for a Principal Technical Sound Designer with deep production experience building and shipping high-quality technical audio systems for AA/AAA games. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone equally comfortable with audio systems architecture, Unreal Engine, Wwise, C++, Blueprints, optimization, mixing, tooling, and hands-on audio production. What You'll Do Architect and build modular, scalable, and portable audio systems from the ground up using C++, Blueprints, Wwise, and Unreal Engine. Work across multiple AA/AAA game projects simultaneously, designing solutions that can scale across projects and teams. Develop deep integrations using the Wwise Unreal Engine API. Design and maintain sophisticated dynamic mixing and spatial audio systems in Wwise, supporting gameplay, dialogue, environments, cinematics, and changing player context. Develop advanced audio functionality using Unreal Engine MetaSounds. Profile and optimize audio for CPU, memory, runtime performance, and platform constraints. Architect and refine scalable, modular, and portable dialogue systems, balancing in-world immersion with gameplay and dialogue clarity. Build Unreal Editor modules, utilities, and tools that improve audio implementation workflows and reduce repetitive work. Create clear technical documentation and how-to guides that enable sound designers and junior technical sound designers to independently use and maintain the systems you build. Contribute hands-on sound design when needed. Deliver high-quality, production-ready results under short deadlines and high-pressure development conditions. What We're Looking For Multiple shipped AA or AAA titles, with professional experience mixing shipped game projects. Experience supporting multiple AA/AAA projects concurrently. Deep expertise with Wwise, its Unreal Engine integration/API, dynamic mixing, and Wwise Spatial Audio. Extensive professional experience with Unreal Engine, C++, Blueprints, and MetaSounds. Proven experience in architecting and building core game-audio systems from scratch. Proven expertise optimizing game audio for CPU and memory performance. Proven experience developing audio systems for networked multiplayer games, including challenges such as replicated audio state/events, latency and synchronization, and multiplayer voice chat. Multiple proven examples of building and refining dialogue systems from the ground up. Deep experience developing Unreal Editor modules, utilities, and workflow tools. Strong technical documentation and knowledge-transfer skills. Professional sound design experience and a strong understanding of how technical systems support creative audio goals. Experience working in horror games or horror-focused interactive audio is strongly valued. At minimum, candidates should demonstrate familiarity with and enthusiasm for the genre and an understanding of how audio systems can support tension, atmosphere, player uncertainty, pacing, and dynamic scares. A demonstrated ability to make strong technical and creative decisions when time, performance, or production constraints are significant. Principal-Level Expectations We’re looking for more than familiarity with these technologies. Strong candidates should be able to demonstrate specific shipped examples of systems they personally architected, built, optimized, documented, and supported in production. Salary Range: The base salary range for this position is listed below. Final compensation within the applicable salary range will be determined based on factors such as the applicant’s experience, qualifications, and work location. San Francisco, CA; New York City, NY; Los Angeles, CA; Seattle, WA; Boston, MA; & Seattle, WA DC Metropolitan Areas:   $164,000- $215,000USD annually Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Nashville, TN; Atlanta, GA; Chicago, IL; Dallas, TX;  Miami, FL,  Portland, OR, Raleigh–Durham, NC, Philadelphia, PA, Minneapolis–St. Paul, MN, Phoenix, AZ Salt Lake City, UT Metropolitan Areas:   $143,000 - $187,000 USD annually All Other U.S. Locations: $121,000 - $159,000 USD annually Benefits: Mob Entertainment offers the following benefits to all eligible U.S.-based full-time employees: profit sharing; medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) matching; FSA/HSA; paid time off; sick time; holidays; and parental leave. Fraud Alert: Beware of job scams: Mob Entertainment does not extend offers via text, social media DM, or without a completed application and interview. Please verify email address which should always originate from @mobentertainment.com. #LI-Remote Mob Entertainment is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and complies with all federal, state, and local laws prohibiting discrimination in employment. We are committed to providing equal opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender, age, disability, military service, or any other protected class under applicable state or local law. Mob Entertainment also considers all qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with Fair Chance laws as well as any other applicable state and local laws.

jobs.title: Senior Tech QA Analyst - Audio
jobs.description: To create revolutionary, story-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind-the-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members! CD PROJEKT RED is looking for a Senior Tech QA Analyst - Audio to take ownership of quality, stability and performance across our shared audio technologies. Working closely with Audio Code, Sound Design, Music and QA teams, you will be responsible for validating complex audio systems, investigating difficult technical problems and building effective testing solutions. You will work across C++, Unreal Engine and Wwise, using debugging and profiling tools to understand not only when something fails, but why. As a Senior, you will own complex technical quality topics end-to-end, make risk-based recommendations, develop testing and automation solutions, improve pipelines and practices, and help other QA team members grow their technical capabilities. Responsibilities Oversee the stability, performance, and quality of shared audio systems throughout the entire development lifecycle. Create comprehensive test strategies and coverage plans to identify technical risks early and define effective validation approaches. Conduct deep-dive investigations and root-cause analysis on complex audio issues using C++, Unreal Engine, and Wwise. Monitor and validate audio system performance metrics, including CPU usage, memory, streaming, and runtime behavior. Design and maintain automated testing solutions, functional test environments, and debugging tools to increase investigation efficiency. Work closely with Audio Code and Design teams to evaluate technical solutions and provide data-driven quality recommendations. Drive improvements to testing pipelines, workflows, and QA practices by researching and integrating new testing technologies. Manage technical QA efforts across in-house and external teams to ensure consistent coverage for complex audio features. Elevate team capabilities through clear technical documentation, knowledge sharing, workshops, and mentoring. 5+ years of professional experience in technical QA, software testing, or game development with a focus on complex technical systems. Proven track record of owning quality, stability, and performance for technical features throughout the development cycle. Strong practical knowledge of Unreal Engine and C++, with the ability to read, investigate, and debug production code. Proficiency with audio middleware like Wwise, including technical debugging and performance profiling. Expertise in using diagnostic and profiling tools such as Unreal Insights, PIX, or Razor to analyze performance data, logs, and traces. Experience designing and implementing automated or programmatic testing solutions, pipelines, and internal tools. Demonstrated ability to perform root-cause analysis across complex systems to identify and resolve technical issues. Skill in designing comprehensive test strategies and coverage plans for technically complex features. Ability to assess technical quality risks and data-driven insights to make actionable recommendations. Nice to have Professional experience in game audio technology, technical audio, or Audio QA with a shipped PC or console title. Hands-on programming experience, including implementing fixes, tooling, or production features. Expertise in creating test frameworks, internal QA tools, and custom testing infrastructure. Experience with automated testing integrated into CI or development pipelines. Strong understanding of audio programming concepts (DSP, mixing, streaming, voice management) and engine-level performance optimization. Advanced Wwise skills, including integration, optimization, and complex profiling. Experience creating debug levels, instrumentation, or visualization tools for complex systems. Working mode Office-First: working primarily from the Warsaw studio in a full time or hybrid mode. Relocation Support Relocation package – flight ticket, company apartment for your first month, relocating your pet, shipping your belongings — it’s all covered. Relocation assistance — processing your legalization operations for you, assistance with finding residence, tax settlements — all you need to feel right at home is taken care of. Polish lessons for foreign employees — and for your spouse or partner, too. Health & Well-Being Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives. Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones. Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company. Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being initiatives. Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city. Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain. RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events. RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majority paid by the company. Perks & Professional Growth A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team. Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn! REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement. Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio. Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together. Healthy selections — ​​canteens. Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world. Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has  electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog. jobs.title: Sound Designer
jobs.description: Who are we? Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world. We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios. Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users. Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others. We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games. Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started. The role is working within our studio: Ludios About Ludios Ludios takes its name from Latin; it means "The Game People". Led by Eyal, one of the co-founders of Tripledot Studios, and some of the most experienced people in mobile games, we are a studio that makes and publishes our own casual, free-to-play mobile games. Our team is based across APAC, with the majority of our development happening in Jakarta and Melbourne. We are data-driven, creative, and genuinely passionate about the industry we work in. Right now, we are working on a number of exciting projects, including one built around a globally recognised IP, alongside several original titles we are equally excited about. If crafting games and reaching millions of players is what gets you out of bed, we would love to hear from you. Role Overview As a Sound Designer at Ludios, you'll be responsible for creating, editing, and implementing audio components for our portfolio of games. You will collaborate with our creative teams to craft an immersive audio experience that compliments the game's visuals and gameplay. Key Responsibilities: Create original and engaging sound design for games, including gameplay actions, user interface interactions, animations, rewards, transitions, and other in-game moments. Take ownership of sound design across multiple features and projects, from initial concept through final delivery. Edit, mix, and master audio to produce polished, balanced results across different devices. Collaborate closely with game designers, artists, developers, producers, and other members of the audio team. Communicate effectively with international colleagues, particularly teams based in London, Barcelona, and Australia. Interpret creative briefs, propose suitable audio direction, and respond constructively to feedback. Review audio within the game, identify areas for improvement, and iterate until the sound supports the intended player experience. Organize audio assets and project files clearly, following consistent naming and delivery practices. Manage priorities and deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines. Contribute positively to team discussions and support a collaborative working environment. Requirements : Strong sound design, sound editing, and mixing skills. A good understanding of audio processing, including equalization, compression, dynamics, spatial effects, and level balancing. Proficiency with at least one professional digital audio workstation. Music composition and production skills Ability to create a complete audio experience using sound effects, audio libraries, voice-over, music, recording, layering, and creative processing. A strong ear for detail, timing, tonal balance, and how sound supports visual feedback and the player experience. Openness to learning and adopting new audio tools, technologies, and workflows. Ability to interpret a creative brief and independently develop an appropriate audio direction. Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English. Strong communication and collaboration skills, including confidence working with colleagues across different locations and time zones. Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks or projects. A reliable and constructive approach to teamwork and feedback. Nice to Have Previous experience creating audio for games, particularly mobile or casual games. An understanding of mobile audio limitations, file optimization, loudness, and playback consistency across devices. Experience with collaborative asset-management workflows. Working at Tripledot Hybrid Working 20 days of remote working: Work from anywhere in the world, or use the time to cover mandatory office days to WFH, 20 days of the year. Regular company events and rewards: Join in regular events and rewards that celebrate cultural events, our achievements, and our team spirit. Breakfast & Lunch: Relish daily breakfast and lunch provided in the office to keep you fueled and focused. BPJS HEALTH: Elevate your well-being and peace of mind, ensuring robust health security with seamless enrolment in BPJS Health. BPJS SOCIAL: Secure your employment rights with BPJS Social. Festivity Allowance: Celebrate festive occasions with an additional festive allowance. Private Health Insurance: Stay covered with comprehensive health insurance for you and your loved ones. Employee Assistance Program: Anytime you need it, tap into confidential, caring support with our Employee Assistance Program, always here to lend an ear and a helping hand. Family Forming Support: Receive vital support on your family forming/ fertility journey with our support program [subject to policy] English Classes: Enhance your English skills with our provided English classes

jobs.title: SoC Audio Engineer, Platform Architecture
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Do you love crafting elegant solutions to the hardest problems in audio and acoustics? Are you a big-picture, forward-thinking engineer who understands how audio subsystems integrate into a SoC and a system? At Apple, our Architecture group is responsible for connecting the hardware and software that bring sound to life across our products. Join this team, and you'll collaborate with engineers across Apple to design how our audio technologies work in unison!
  
  
Description
  
  
We are looking for a SoC Audio Architect to join our team defining the audio subsystem architecture for Apple's SoCs — technology that powers experiences across nearly every Apple product, from ultra-low-power keyword detection to high-fidelity spatial audio. This is primarily an audio subsystem architecture role, not an audio IP design role; experience designing audio IP is valued as background but is not the core function of the position. In this highly visible role, you will own the multi-generational subsystem architecture and roadmap for audio subsystems, collaborating closely with Silicon Engineering, Software Engineering, and Hardware Engineering teams to size subsystems and optimize trade-offs between performance, power, and area. You will have visibility across every product line and be accountable for architectures that scale across the portfolio, from early concept through tape-out and into shipping product.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree
* Experience with SoC architecture principles
* Experience with SoC audio processing

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Master's degree with 10+ years of relevant industry experience
* Experience defining architecture specifications for audio, DSP, or signal processing subsystems within an SoC
* In-depth understanding of SoC architecture concepts, such as on-chip fabric protocols, memory concepts, and clocking, reset, and power management
* Skilled in digital signal processing algorithms, including audio algorithms
* Understanding of SoC power modeling and Power/Performance/Area (PPA) optimization
* Understanding of SoC audio interfaces (e.g., I2S, PDM, TDM, MIPI SWI3S)
* Proficiency in hardware/software co-design, including familiarity with RTL design concepts (e.g., System Verilog)
* Excellent interpersonal, leadership, and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence across organizations.

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $175,000 and $263,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.  
  
  

Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We seek to promote equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. Learn more about your EEO rights as an applicant

  
  
  

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

jobs.title: IT Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Suno**
==============

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

**About the Role**
------------------

Our Los Angeles office is home to Suno's largest concentration of musicians, producers, and music-industry partners, and the technology they depend on is different from a typical office: studios, DAWs, audio interfaces, monitoring, high-resolution playback, and the networks and storage that move large sessions around. As Staff IT Engineer, you'll own the audio and studio technology domain for Suno company-wide — designing, building, and supporting the production environments our Music team works in — while also serving as the senior IT presence on the ground in LA.

You'll report to the Senior Manager, IT Operations and work alongside IT Engineers in Cambridge, NYC, and San Francisco, who manage identity, endpoint, SaaS, and office-infrastructure. You'll work with the rest of the team to manage our Corporate IT systems stack, but you'll be our audio and A/V expert.

**Listen to the song we made about it:** https://suno.com/s/ldMCcRAh5ln0LgNA

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Run IT for the LA office** — identity and onboarding, endpoint management, SaaS Administration, wired/wireless networking, zero-trust VPN, and A/V and videoconferencing.
* **Own audio and studio systems as a domain** — set the standard for how Suno builds and supports production spaces across offices: studio and listening-room design in partnership with acousticians and integrators, DAW and plugin management, audio interfaces and I/O, monitoring and calibration, and the storage and networking that production work needs.
* **Support the Music team at a professional bar** — keep sessions running; manage DAW environments (Pro Tools, Logic, Ableton, and others), licensing, plugin fleets, and audio drivers across a Mac fleet; troubleshoot latency, clocking, and routing problems the rest of IT can't.
* **Partner on the product** — work with Engineering and the Suno Studio team to make sure internal creators have the hardware, routing, and environments they need to use and test our tools the way professional producers do.
* **Design for the next space** — specify audio, A/V, and network requirements for LA buildouts and expansions and for studio spaces in other offices; manage integrators and vendors to a result.
* **Scale support** — write runbooks and knowledge articles that let office managers and AI-powered self-service handle the routine, and automate what you've done twice.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

### **Must-Haves**

* 10+ years of IT engineering experience, including significant time supporting professional audio production environments — studios, post-production, broadcast, live, or music-technology companies.
* Deep professional-audio competence — signal flow, digital audio (sample rates, clocking, word clock, Dante or AVB), DAW administration, audio interfaces and converters, monitoring and room calibration — and the ability to diagnose problems producers describe by ear.
* Demonstrated breadth across the IT stack — identity, endpoint, SaaS administration, networking, and office IT — with the depth to operate independently as the only IT engineer in an office.
* Experience owning a technical domain end to end — you've set the standard others follow, not just executed it.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you can work comfortably with producers, engineers, executives, and vendors, and translate between them.
* Learning agility — you pick up new platforms quickly, you're comfortable being the first person at the company to figure something out, and you aren't afraid to ask for help.

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Studio design and buildout experience — acoustic treatment, room tuning, patchbay and infrastructure design, working with acousticians and AV integrators.
* Hands-on experience with a modern IdP (Okta or equivalent), modern Apple MDM (Iru, Jamf, Jumpcloud), and endpoint security (CrowdStrike or similar).
* Networking depth — AV-over-IP, multicast, QoS for audio networks, and managed switching.
* Experience supporting creative or music teams at a technology company, or IT at a label, studio, or music-tech company.
* Comfort with at least one scripting language (Python, TypeScript, or Bash) and config-as-code approaches.
* Working knowledge of music production — you've made or recorded music yourself.

**Work Location Policy**
------------------------

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

**Additional Notes**

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Willingness to travel (up to 20%) to collaborate with team members and support studio spaces across Suno office locations.

Audio Artist II – Speech Production EA SPORTS™ NHL Who We Are EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment – connecting hundreds of millions around the world to the sports they love through a portfolio of industry-leading video games. We've pioneered award-winning creative technology and experiences to connect players to the speed, skill, and heart of the NHL. Role Overview We are looking for an Audio Artist II to join the EA SPORTS NHL Audio team. The primary focus of this role is mastering, organising, and delivering high-quality recorded speech for commentary, voice-over, and other in-game experiences. You will also support speech-production workflows using AI tools that help the team maintain content at scale. Reporting to the Audio Lead, you will work independently within a defined area, applying editorial judgement and technical discipline to ensure assets meet creative, pipeline, and in-game quality standards. The Challenge Ahead Your challenge will be to turn recorded and generated source material into game-ready assets while maintaining accuracy across naming, metadata, versioning, and delivery. You will review content critically and work with speech leads, audio leadership, production, and technical partners to resolve issues. You will contribute ideas within your area, help improve established workflows, estimate your work with guidance, and communicate status, dependencies, and risks early. Who You Are You are an audio professional with dialogue-editing and mastering skills. You are comfortable working through high volumes of content without losing consistency, and you understand how editorial choices affect clarity, authenticity, and the player experience. You evaluate and integrate new tools through active testing and structured analysis. You will review audio outputs to identify artifacts and inconsistencies, correct manageable issues through direct editing, and escalate complex problems to the speech team. You will maintain structured asset workflows, integrate team reviews into your daily process, and implement solutions to increase our audio processing pipeline's reliability. Responsibilities Master, clean, and quality-check commentary, dialogue, and other speech assets. Use approved speech-generation and processing tools to create or adapt content, then evaluate and prepare outputs to team standards. Identify issues involving noise, level, dynamics, spectral balance, timing, pronunciation, continuity, or processing artifacts. Maintain accurate naming, metadata, versioning, source files, and delivery structures. Prepare, import, and validate speech assets in game-audio tools, databases, and established pipelines. Track assigned work, provide estimates with lead support, and communicate priorities, dependencies, and schedule risks. Participate in troubleshooting and recommend practical improvements to tools and workflows. Document processes and share knowledge. Requirements Professional experience editing and mastering dialogue, commentary, VO, ADR, broadcast, or comparable speech content. Advanced proficiency with Pro Tools or another professional DAW, including dialogue cleanup, EQ, dynamics, noise reduction, loudness control, and batch workflows. Demonstrated experience evaluating audio to identify subtle quality, consistency, and processing errors. 3+ years of experience managing assets against technical specifications, naming conventions, metadata, and version-control requirements. Experience with game-audio authoring tools, databases, or content pipelines. You will document technical workflows, track project milestones, and coordinate asset deliveries across multiple technical and creative departments. Experience with modern speech-production, voice-processing, automation, or scripting workflows is an asset. jobs.title: Concepteur audio technique / Technical Audio Designer
jobs.description: En tant que concepteur audio technique, vous vous situez à l’intersection du design sonore et de l’ingénierie, transformant les éléments audio en systèmes en jeu performants et peaufinés. En collaboration avec les concepteurs sonores, les ingénieurs et les concepteurs techniques, vous intégrerez l’audio dans Unreal Engine et Wwise, concevrez des outils et optimiserez les performances. Il s’agit d’un rôle pratique destiné à une personne souhaitant évoluer à la jonction de la création et de la technique. Contrat de 12 mois Responsabilités: Intégrer les éléments audio dans Unreal Engine à l’aide du moteur sonore Wwise, de l’élément source jusqu’au système jouable. Concevoir et maintenir des systèmes audio basés sur les Blueprints. Développer et améliorer des outils permettant d’accélérer le flux de travail des concepteurs sonores. Profiler et optimiser l’audio en termes de CPU, mémoire, nombre de voix et flux (streaming) à l’aide du Wwise Profiler et d’Unreal Audio Insights. Respecter les directives d’organisation des données et de mixage de Wwise afin de garantir la cohérence du contenu et sa capacité à passer à l’échelle. Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes audio en collaboration avec l’équipe de développement. Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique des fonctionnalités, outils et flux de travail audio. Communiquer clairement les progrès et les contraintes techniques aux collaborateurs non techniques. Exigences: 3 ans ou plus d’expérience en audio technique, incluant un cycle de production complet jusqu’au lancement du jeu. Compétences démontrables en intégration audio avec Unreal Engine et Wwise. Solide maîtrise des Blueprints Unreal pour l’intégration audio. Maîtrise de Wwise. Connaissance pratique d’une station de travail audio numérique (DAW) telle que Reaper ou Pro Tools. Fortes capacités de résolution de problèmes et souci du détail. Capacité à apprendre rapidement de nouvelles technologies, outils et concepts. Bonnes aptitudes en communication et travail d’équipe, incluant la capacité d’expliquer des contraintes techniques à des collaborateurs non techniques. Intérêt réel pour l’audio technique appliqué au jeu vidéo, couplé à une bonne oreille. Atouts: Bonne compréhension de Wwise Spatial Audio. Connaissance pratique de l’API Wwise Authoring (WAAPI). Compétences en programmation d’scripts en Python ou C#. Connaissance de base du C++ et de son rôle dans Unreal Engine. Technical Audio Designer As a Technical Audio Designer, you sit between sound design and engineering, turning audio assets into polished, performant in-game systems. Working with audio designers, engineers, and technical designers, you will implement audio in Unreal Engine and Wwise, build tooling, and optimize for performance. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to grow at the intersection of creative and technical craft. 12-month contract Responsibilities: Integrate audio assets into Unreal Engine using the Wwise sound engine, from source asset to playable system. Build and maintain Blueprint-based audio systems. Develop and improve tools that speed up the audio designers' workflow. Profile and optimize audio for CPU, memory, voice count, and streaming using the Wwise Profiler and Unreal Audio Insights. Uphold Wwise data organization and mixing guidelines so content stays consistent and scales across the project. Troubleshoot and resolve audio issues in collaboration with the development team. Write and maintain technical documentation for audio features, tools, and workflows. Communicate progress and technical constraints clearly to non-technical collaborators. Required: 3+ years of technical audio experience, including one full production cycle through ship. Demonstrable audio implementation skills with Unreal Engine and Wwise. Strong command of Unreal Blueprints for audio implementation. Proficient with Wwise. Working knowledge of a DAW such as Reaper or Pro Tools. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to quickly learn new technology, tools, and concepts. Good communication and teamwork abilities, including explaining technical constraints to non-technical collaborators. Genuine interest in technical audio for games, with a good ear. Nice to have: Good understanding of Wwise Spatial Audio. Working knowledge of the Wwise Authoring API (WAAPI). Scripting abilities in Python or C#. Surface level understanding of C++ and its role in Unreal Engine. Justification des exigences linguistiques NetEase s'engage à favoriser un environnement de travail francophone pour ses employés au Québec. Tous les efforts ont été faits pour éviter d'exiger une langue autre que le français pour ce poste. Cependant, la maîtrise de l'anglais est essentielle pour ce poste, car l'employé devra communiquer régulièrement avec des collègues et des parties prenantes situés à l'extérieur du Québec, où l'anglais est la principale langue de communication entre les bureaux. Language Requirement Justification NetEase is committed to supporting a French-speaking workenvironment for its employees in Quebec. Every effort has been made to avoidrequiring a language other than French for this position. However, proficiency in English is essential for thisrole because the employee will be required to communicate regularly with colleagues and stakeholders located outside Quebec, where English is theprimary language of communication between offices.
